feeds.title: The New Yorker
feeds.description: In 1925, Harold Ross established The New Yorker as a lighthearted, Manhattan-centric magazine. Today The New Yorker is considered by many to be the most influential magazine in the world, renowned for its in-depth reporting, political and cultural commentary, fiction, poetry, and humor.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » News
feeds.description: In-depth reporting, commentary on breaking news, political analysis, and opinion from The New Yorker.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Culture
feeds.description: Cultural news and criticism, and conversations about TV, theatre, movies, and music, as well as Goings On About Town listings from The New Yorker.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Humor
feeds.description: Humor from The New Yorker, including satire news, funny cartoons and comics.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Magazine
feeds.description: The New Yorker Magazine features articles including news, in-depth reporting, commentary and analysis. It also features articles with a mix of reporting on politics and culture, humor and cartoons, fiction and poetry, and reviews and criticism.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Business
feeds.description: Analysis of the latest news in business, economics, science, and technology from The New Yorker.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » The Sporting Scene
feeds.description: Get news and information from the world of sports football, baseball, basketball, hockey, boxing, and more from The New Yorker.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » The Political Scene Podcast
feeds.description: A weekly discussion about politics, hosted by The New Yorker's executive editor.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Fiction
feeds.description: A monthly reading and conversation with the New Yorker fiction editor.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Poetry Podcast
feeds.description: Readings and conversation with The New Yorker's poetry editor.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Cartoons
feeds.description: Cartoons from The New Yorker's stable of cartoonists. Check out the latest drawings, or browse the magazine's archives.

feeds.title: The New Yorker Radio Hour
feeds.description: Profiles, storytelling and insightful conversations, hosted by David Remnick.

feeds.title: The New Yorker » Books
feeds.description: The latest book reviews, literary criticism, and news, along with new weekly fiction, poetry, and podcasts from The New Yorker.
